correctness.rationale: The prime-power Ramanujan sum coefficient pattern gives the factorization, already known. Modulo p, E(X)=(X-1)^{(p-2)P}; E(1)=p(p-1)/2 has valuation exactly one, proving translated Eisenstein and total ramification with all alpha-1 valuations 1/d. Positive descending coefficients imply Eneström--Kakeya annulus for beta=alpha^P, bounded between (p-1)/(p-2) and 2; P is odd for odd p so the unique negative real root of Q_p remains unique for E. Identity (Y-1)^2 Q_p(Y)=Y^p-pY+(p-1) gives derivative at every root and resultant/discriminant under power composition; sign from (d-1)/2 nonreal pairs. Independent exact prime-power coefficient, shifted valuation and symbolic Sylvester resultant tests passed eight representative cases. The proof covers all odd primes and exponents, not merely tests.
